items.fromString:
As a System User,

I want to set an optional Energy sharing model on a Point of Delivery (POD) version,

So that I can record whether the POD participates as an Energy group or an Energy community.

 

h3. Description

This story adds one non-mandatory dropdown on the POD version named Energy sharing model (EN: Energy sharing model | BG: Модел на споделяне). Allowed values are Energy group (EN: Energy group | BG: Енергийна група) and Energy community (EN: Energy community | BG: Енергийна общност). The System User may leave the field empty.

 

h3. Preconditions

* System User has permission to view, edit and create Point of Delivery (POD),including creating or editing a POD version and create Express contract(add Point of Delivery)
* A POD exists and the System User can open it in create-version or edit-version mode as today.
* Existing POD version save and versioning behavior is available as today.

 

h3. Acceptance Criteria

*Field on POD version*

*  On POD version create and edit screens, System shows a dropdown labelled (EN: Energy sharing model | BG: Модел на споделяне).
* Energy sharing model is not mandatory. System User can save a POD version with the field empty.
* The dropdown offers exactly these selectable values (plus empty / no selection):
** (EN: Energy group | BG: Енергийна група)
** (EN: Energy community | BG: Енергийна общност)
* System does not allow any other custom free-text value in Energy sharing model.
* Field is editable when the System User is allowed to edit the POD version; when the POD version is view-only, the field is read-only / display-only as for other version fields today.

*Point of Delivery - mass import*

* New field must be added in POD mass import with same validations

*Express Contract - Add Point of Delivery pop-up*

* In Express Contract, on the Point of Delivery tab, in the Add Point of Delivery pop-up, System shows the same Energy sharing model dropdown with the same label and values as on POD version.
* Energy sharing model is not mandatory in the express contract. System User can add a Point of Delivery with the field empty
* System does not allow any value other than empty, Energy group or Energy community in the Express contract
* When System User confirms Add Point of Delivery with a selected value, System stores that value on the related POD version. When left empty, System stores empty

h3. Persistence and display

* When System User selects Energy group and saves successfully, System persists Energy group on that POD version and shows Energy group when the version is reopened.
* When System User selects Energy community and saves successfully, System persists Energy community on that POD version and shows Energy community when the version is reopened.
* When System User leaves the field empty or clears a previous selection and saves successfully, System persists empty and shows no selected value when the version is reopened.

Language

* In English UI language, the label and option texts shown are the EN texts above.
* In Bulgarian UI language, the label and option texts shown are the BG texts above.
